verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Devin MCP server doc, which says it exposes "scheduling" alongside session management. That implies Devin has its own scheduling capability, but nothing shows the schedules recur rather than being one-off delayed sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring or cron-style schedules, how schedules are configured and managed, workflow scheduling details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
